s1.syndrome_frame: A painful polypoid mass on the gingiva with a history of previous chemoradiotherapy for squamous cell carcinoma, presenting with trismus and bone resorption
salient_findings: 10-mm polypoid mass on the left lower gingiva
Moth-eaten pattern of mandibular bone resorption on panoramic radiography
Biopsy showing loose granulation tissue with atypical spindle and pleomorphic cells
key_facts: Pain and a polypoid mass on the left lower gingiva
History of chemoradiotherapy 15 years earlier for squamous cell carcinoma of the left buccal mucosa
Rough-surfaced polypoid lesion in the left lower molar gingiva covered by a whitish pseudomembrane
Biopsy specimen showed loose granulation tissue with scattered atypical spindle and pleomorphic cells
Immunohistochemical staining revealed positivity for vimentin, α-smooth muscle actin, p63, p53, and CD68

Moth-eaten pattern of mandibular bone resorption on panoramic radiography

shortlist.label: Spindle cell squamous cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: p63 positivity indicates epithelial differentiation and history of squamous cell carcinoma

shortlist.label: Sarcomatoid carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: presence of atypical spindle and pleomorphic cells with high Ki-67 labeling index

shortlist.label: Malignant fibrous histiocytoma
shortlist.why_kept: immunohistochemical staining revealed positivity for vimentin and CD68

shortlist.label: Undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: presence of atypical spindle and pleomorphic cells with high Ki-67 labeling index and lack of obvious lineage differentiation

shortlist.label: Inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor
shortlist.why_kept: presence of loose granulation tissue with scattered atypical spindle cells and positivity for α-smooth muscle actin

raw.rationale: The patient's history of chemoradiotherapy for squamous cell carcinoma and the presence of atypical spindle and pleomorphic cells with immunohistochemical staining positivity for p63, which indicates epithelial differentiation, support this diagnosis. The high Ki-67 labeling index also suggests a malignant process.

rejected.label: Spindle cell squamous cell carcinoma
rejected.why: While p63 positivity suggests epithelial differentiation, the absence of clear squamous cell carcinoma features and the predominance of spindle cells make this less likely.

rejected.label: Malignant fibrous histiocytoma
rejected.why: Now considered a subtype of undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma, and the presence of p63 positivity points more towards a carcinoma origin.

rejected.label: Undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma
rejected.why: The presence of p63 positivity and the patient's history of squamous cell carcinoma suggest a carcinomatous origin rather than a purely sarcomatous one.

rejected.label: Inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor
rejected.why: Typically has a more benign clinical course and lacks the high-grade atypia and mitotic activity seen in this case.
